package fixture

import (
	"strings"

	core "github.com/johanix/tdns/v2/core"
	"github.com/miekg/dns"
)

// The safe fold, as a key.
func keyDirect(rrs []dns.RR, out map[string][]dns.RR) {
	for _, rr := range rrs {
		out[core.CanonicalizeName(rr.Header().Name)] = nil
	}
}

func keyViaLocal(name string, m map[string]bool) bool {
	k := core.CanonicalizeName(dns.Fqdn(name))
	return m[k]
}

func zoneNameKey(name string) string {
	return core.CanonicalizeName(dns.Fqdn(name))
}

// Tested through a fold, sliced by length -- the affix cannot survive.
func stripPrefix(owner string) string {
	const p = "_dns."
	if strings.HasPrefix(core.CanonicalizeName(owner), p) {
		return owner[len(p):]
	}
	return owner
}

func sameZone(qname, zonename string) bool {
	return core.EqualNames(qname, zonename)
}

func inZone(qname, zonename string) bool {
	return dns.IsSubDomain(zonename, qname)
}

// Folding a NON-name is fine: an algorithm name, a config identifier.
func algKey(alg string, m map[string]bool) bool {
	return m[strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(alg))]
}

// A block comment hides code from a parser, which is the point of using one.
